_readme: Known files over the 500-line convention (claudedocs/server.md, '单文件 500 行收敛' — tools/ adopted the same rule 2026-08-13, G4). Paths below are relative to tools/ (the --root passed to the shared scripts/checkFileLength.mjs). Schema: { "path": { "lines": <number>, "reason": "<why this is a justified exception>" } }. checkFileLength.mjs fails CI only if a file NOT listed here crosses 500 lines, a listed file grows past the line count recorded here, or an entry has no 'reason' or exceeds the 800-line hard cap.

level-editor/src/board/BoardPanel.ts.reason: Single canvas input+render panel: onDown/onMove/onPathDown/onPathDrag (input) and render/drawPaths/drawHandle/drawSpawnMarker/etc. (drawing) all share the same coordinate-transform helpers (rowToY/cellAt/localXY/cellCenter) and read/mutate the same EditorState — one board, one input surface, one render pass, no clean module boundary. Grew 516->543 (2026-08-13, 'tools coverage Phase 4'): rowToY/cellAt/laneHeaderAt/cellCenter/hitHandle/baseTint lifted from private instance methods into exported free functions (taking cell/header explicitly instead of reading off `this`) so they're unit-testable without a canvas/DOM — the existing instance methods now delegate to them 1:1, behavior unchanged. Extraction adds exported wrapper surface, it doesn't reduce the file; the structural reason above (one input+render panel, shared coordinate/state coupling) still holds and is why this stays a baseline exception rather than a real split.
